query: 水风险评估 水风险评估 衡量企业识别、评估和管理水风险的体系成熟度。 内容质量得分 (取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：使用了专业风险识别工具（如 WRI Aqueduct），具备水压力情景分析，有针对高风险站点的应对措施，且建立了水资源治理机制（如首席水官或专项考核）。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的水风险识别和定性描述，具备通用性应对措施（如节水计划），但缺乏针对性工具应用或深度的情景评估。 • 0分（不合格）：无水风险评估披露，或仅笼统提及“重视水资源保护”。 水风险评估 水压力 基准水压力 水资源短缺 干旱风险 洪涝风险 流域风险 高水压力地区 高风险站点 水压力情景分析 WRI Aqueduct WWF水风险过滤器 water risk assessment water stress baseline water stress water scarcity drought risk flood risk basin risk high water stress areas high-risk sites water stress scenario WRI Aqueduct WWF Water Risk Filter 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '水风险评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视节水”；仅有用水效益目标而无风险评估；仅有排污合规数据；仅有社区饮水公益项目；区分：水风险评估关注风险识别工具、情景与高风险站点应对；用水效益目标与行动方案关注节水量化目标及工程/管理措施，二者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In 2020, the Group formally established the Sustainability Committee to carry out planning, risk identification and assessment on ESG matters. The committee, which includes 2 independent non-executive directors and 3 executive directors, regularly convenes committee meetings with the management and external consultants of the Group to ensure that the management and all employees are involved in and engaged in the Group's sustainability management. We carry out the Group's comprehensive sustainability management with a sustainable development hierarchy to ensure that the management and frontline employees identify the Group's ESG responsibilities, and voluntarily participate in ESG management, so as to jointly realize the Group's sustainable development vision.

results.text: Impro Group also includes the performance of suppliers in environmental and social aspects into the scope of important evaluation. In the Supplier Code of Conduct, we clarify the standards based on environmental protection and employment. Suppliers are required to provide MSDS certification and test reports on all ingredients, and to fill in the Environmental Condition Survey Form and sign the Supplier Environmental Notification. As at the end of the Reporting Period, 110 suppliers have obtained ISO 14001 system certification. At the same time, we pay attention to the risk management of suppliers, refine supplier types, and strengthen the supplier access evaluation to avoid risks. During the pandemic, the Group tracked the information of the suppliers in the regions where the pandemic occurred and tried to avoid a concentration of suppliers from one region. In the case of suppliers with a single patent, the Group tried to avoid the ordering of goods in a single region, stabilize supply and reduce risks through communication.

GOVERNANCE & OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITY / 1.4. INDUSTRY CO-CONSTRUCTION

[Content]
Impro Group also includes the performance of suppliers in environmental and social aspects into the scope of important evaluation. In the Supplier Code of Conduct, we clarify the standards based on environmental protection and employment. Suppliers are required to provide MSDS certification and test reports on all ingredients, and to fill in the Environmental Condition Survey Form and sign the Supplier Environmental Notification. As at the end of the Reporting Period, 110 suppliers have obtained ISO 14001 system certification. At the same time, we pay attention to the risk management of suppliers, refine supplier types, and strengthen the supplier access evaluation to avoid risks. During the pandemic, the Group tracked the information of the suppliers in the regions where the pandemic occurred and tried to avoid a concentration of suppliers from one region. In the case of suppliers with a single patent, the Group tried to avoid the ordering of goods in a single region, stabilize supply and reduce risks through communication.

[Section]
ENVIRONMENTAL RESPONSIBILITY

[Content]
While optimizing the Group's internal management system, we continuously work on certification of environmental management systems. During the Reporting Period, our plants in China, Turkey, Germany, Czech Republic and Mexico have already passed and obtained the ISO 14001 Environmental Management System Certification, accounting for approximately 58% of the total number of plants. During the Reporting Period, we revised our documents including Emergency Plans for Environmental Incidents and Risk Evaluation Report to ensure operational compliance. In addition, the Group conducted trainings and drills based on the emergency plans to implement institutional documents while enhancing environmental protection awareness of employees.
